stem.en: Attack two: "The boiled seed has the loop's every part. Same molecules, same tape. You cannot point to a missing piece."

text.en: "Not a missing piece: a broken arrow. Its machines are unfolded, so nothing catches energy, so nothing is kept, so nothing is built or copied. A loop with one arrow cut is not a loop. The Levelling has already arrived, and no part of it can climb back."
"The boiled seed lost its vital force in the boiling."

feedback.en: Book IV's Wohler and Book V's dial lab explained the boiled seed without any force: folds lost to heat, at the valley floor. The card came down.

text.en: "The boiled seed is alive, just resting."

feedback.en: The dry seed is resting: paused and restartable. The boiled seed has been soaked for a year in the sim and does nothing. Paused and broken are different.

image.alt: Kabir's second Epilogue attack, holding up the boiled seed sample and arguing it has every part of the loop yet is still dead.
